registration: Reuse the original 4061-row model fitting pool and its separate 808, 817 and 807 development panels. After the first ordinary outer comparison, no new method may reuse that 1624-row score as its qualification.
candidates: Compare the same fixed TabICLv2 checkpoint in two new ways. A global representation retains every field and appends the discovered profile key, context key and out-of-fold aligned-field tokens. A conditional representation selects a gate from training associations. For each supported gate level it uses all local fitting rows plus up to half as many different-level rows, sampled with a preference for profiles present locally. Cap at six local estimators and fall back to the previously frozen global model for unsupported or unseen levels. Log physical fits and all four preprocessing views per call.
comparison: Use the previously promoted equal mix of the aligned tree and raw TabICL as reference. Elect once on nomination among keeping it and replacing half or all of its raw TabICL component with one new representation. Break ties towards the unchanged mean, then towards less replacement. Lock before observing new candidate scores on the two later panels. Advance only if both gains are nonnegative and their pooled gain over the reference is at least 0.30 percentage points. Report each candidate's nomination score. A positive result must face a different training-only comparison before higher-level adoption.
data: No dataset, column names or fixed column positions in either representation. No additional labels, text generation, model API, course validation or official test.
